== Summary ==
Identified: [[Joe Olson]], [[Tom Haid]], [[Barry Alperstein]] and [[Greg Shaw]]. Remaining faces unlabeled.
Top 8 players gathered around the time of the Top 8 photo, with [[Joe Olson]] at left (blue hoodie). Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

'''Identification:''' Joe Olson's face and light-blue hoodie match his place in [[:File:2021 World Championship Top 8.jpg]] (taken by the same camera minutes earlier) and his face matches [[:File:Joe Olson 2020 Player of the Year.jpg]].

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
* '''Camera timestamp:''' 2021:10:09 04:58:29 (EXIF; camera clock not verified)
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-10-20
